data.sub: Australia ki womens league mein 75 sekund ki deri par ballebaz bina gend khele clean bold ho gayi.

chat.say: Arre umpire sahab abhi toh ground par aaya tha!
Mene toh bina bowling kiye hi wicket le liya bhai.

data.asar: Office pahunchne mein 2 minute late hone par boss bhi ab kuch aise hi out kar dega.
data.caption:
Cricket ki duniya mein ajeeb hi naya rule aa gaya hai bhai! 

🏏 Australia ki womens league mein dekhne ko mila anokha nazaara
⏱️ 75 sekund ki deri ki wajah se ballebaz bina gend khele hui clean bold

Aise out hone se toh achha hai banda ghar hi baitha rahe! 😅

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega
